segments.t: Nastya quickly pulls bartender Kostya away from the bustling restaurant into a quiet storage corner. She wants to make sure nobody can overhear their private conversation. Kostya is curious and ready to assist her with whatever she needs. Let's listen to their brief exchange in Russian first.

Здесь действительно очень тихо и спокойно.

Только пообещай никому ничего не рассказывать.
